create.name: Naomi Goodlet
create.bio:
Naomi Goodlet is an Australian counsellor and meditation guide who has been recording free guided practices for more than fifteen years. She first made mindfulness recordings in 2010 so the people she worked with could keep practising at home, handing them out on CDs and memory sticks, and later posted them online, where a much wider audience found them. Her library now runs to well over a hundred free practices, shared on YouTube, Insight Timer, Spotify and Apple Music.

Her recordings range widely. Some are simple mindfulness exercises drawn from acceptance and commitment work, such as watching thoughts float past like leaves on a stream or riding out an urge with the breath; others are devotional and energetic, including violet flame cleansing, a protection meditation with Archangel Michael, chakra meditations and affirmations for feeling connected to the universe. She also offers breathing practices for calming the nervous system, self-love meditations and gentle sessions for sleep. Alongside the meditations she hosts the Imperfect Habits podcast on self-development and behaviour change. She is training as a psychologist and sees clients at a practice in Robina on the Gold Coast; she is a mother of two.
